cases.refreshed: Come practice your reading skills and read aloud to a friendly dog or cat -- your very own furry audience! You can bring a book from home or borrow one from the Children's Room. This program is perfect for emergent readers. Children in grades K-8 are welcome to participate. Online registration for 10-minute sessions opens Wednesday, November 25, at 8:00 AM. Reserve spots only for children who will participate. When you register, provide each child's name and a parent's email address. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3947, or email us at ask@lib.sccgov.org.
